tags.description: Opened in 1908; it is the oldest park in Calgary. War memorials were added to the grounds and the park was renamed Central Memorial Park in 1928. The park (including the library) was declared a National Historic Site in 2018.
tags.name: Central Memorial Park

tags.description: Man-made pond; the Prince's Island Lagoon hosts free outdoor ice skating in winter (weather-dependent).
tags.name: Prince's Island Lagoon

tags.description: City-owned land intended for housing and other purposes but used as an art park in the meantime; Hillhurst-Sunnyside Community Association manages the area
